protocol: official Text4Seg refer_seg harness (model_refer_seg -> eval_refer_seg): cIoU = sum intersection / sum union over referring expressions; mIoU = mean per-expression IoU; masks from generated R-RLE text and SAM-H refinement. n = number of referring expressions in the official RefCOCO val split.
env: conda glod-ris: Python 3.10, torch 2.2.1+cu121, transformers 4.49.0; model lmc22/text4seg-llava-7b-p24 (HuggingFace, released quick-inference checkpoint); SAM ViT-H
notes: Full official RefCOCO val run with the released p24 checkpoint and SAM ViT-H refinement. Local harness fixes required to execute the released code as intended: the repo calls the one-argument translate_sequence that no longer exists (restored the official demo mapping), the SAM mask_input variable was undefined (now the predicted low-res mask, matching model_semantic_seg.py), and llava/eval/utils.py was missing torch/F imports. Generation was batched by image (group 8) as an implementation detail; outputs were smoke-validated against the sequential path. mIoU/cIoU are the generated-text masks; sam_* are the SAM-refined masks.
